Filtered Heuristics for Text Classificat.Description: Research heuristics specifically selected for their relevance to text classification hypothesis generation from observational data.
Most_Suitable: Investigate deviations from expectations: Notice outliers or anomalies and ask why they occur.
Question the norm: Explore why a widely accepted pattern exists.
Generate theories from conflict: Integrate contradictory findings from different sources.
Challenge core assumptions: Consider circumstances where the opposite of a familiar assumption or a reverse in causal direction might be true.
Stress-test ideas: Strengthen your argument by actively trying to find flaws or alternative explanations.
Moderately_Suitable: Create novel syntheses: Connect concepts from unrelated research to find new insights.
Alternate induction and deduction: Use iterative cycles of inducing general principles and inferring new specific hypotheses.
Transferring conceptualizations analogously: Transfer concepts or methods from one field to another.
